title: General Material Blend 4-Mix Solo #10 (세로 띠·물결 | 스테인드글라스+석재+흑요암금+뱀비늘)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Nigerian woman, an adult, in her early 20s, sultry expression, warm radiant skin tone — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Huge rounded shoulders and thick, powerfully muscular arms with the swell of the muscle visible beneath a soft layer, a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, colossal thighs with a muscular sweep visible beneath the fat, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter glowing on the cheekbones, bold shimmering gold and emerald eyeshadow blended out toward the temples, dramatic long lashes, sharply defined brows, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong glossy fuchsia-pink lip, a bright, joyful smile, bold vivid electric-blue hair styled in flat glossy finger waves styled close to the scalp, real pores, real living eyes, 8 drop dangles piercings set with opals in bronze-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of gold a ring. Full body fused with 4 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 4 vertical bands by 3 hazy transition zones centred about 27% of the way across her figure from her left edge, about 53% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 68% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Region 1 is everything to her left of the first transition zone: it carries solid thick stained glass fused to her form, hundreds of small individual panes each no larger than a coin, BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD and VIVID GOLD panes alternating in a dense irregular mosaic, dark lead-line seams webbing between every pane. Region 2 is the strip between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries solid polished black granite fused directly into her own form, fine natural speckled texture flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING deep charcoal-black granite surface with VIVID silver mineral fleck detail. Region 3 is the strip between transition zone 2 and transition zone 3: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Region 4 is everything to her right of the last transition zone: it carries snake scales (diamond-shaped angular scales aligned in neat overlapping rows), BLAZING PALE GOLD scale formations, VIVID IVORY WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The materials of every region continue in full strength over her whole figure, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on her hip, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
